title: Where India's snow leopards live
caption:
Two in three are in Ladakh.

Only 241 different snow leopards were actually photographed; 718 is a model-based estimate covering over 70% of the cat's potential range in India.

Source: Wildlife Institute of India / MoEFCC, Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India (SPAI), Jan 2024.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
